description_for_human: Drive your own Opera browser from ChatGPT: list tabs, read pages, click, fill, navigate.
description_for_model: Drive the user's own Opera browser session through a strict allowlist of generic browser primitives. Call runBrowserCommand with a method (tabs.list, page.find, page.read, page.click, page.fill, tabs.navigate, browser.burst), params, and waitMs. A successful command and a structured device-side failure both return HTTP 200: read the envelope (ok true, or ok false with an actionable error) and never treat HTTP 200 alone as success. On 504/502 the action may already have run: verify page state before repeating, and pass requestId for replay protection. Never enter passwords, OTPs, payment data, upload files, publish, purchase, send, or delete without the user's explicit instruction.
